checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'ad-copy'.

checks.description: Each variant has id, segment, headline, body, one cta, language.
checks.rule: Every variant object includes id, segment, headline, body, cta, language (ar|en).

checks.description: Each variant carries exactly one CTA.
checks.rule: Each variant has a single cta value; no variant lists two competing actions.

checks.description: At least two variants per segment so a test can compare.
checks.rule: For every segment present, two or more distinct variants exist.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file or example copy.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669); digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in Arabic copy.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+0640 tatweel characters.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name.
checks.rule: Headlines and bodies reference only offers and prices traceable to the brief; absent ones trigger stop-and-ask.
Variants speak to what the reader can build, not to what they lack; no shaming or hype.

checks.description: Named copy frameworks stay optional, the Arabic-first voice stays primary.
checks.rule: The 4 Us, PAS, AIDA, and the 4 Cs are offered as optional tools to test a line against and matched to funnel stage; they are not imposed as mandatory structure over the voice.
